title: Union-Find (Disjoint Sets)
summary: Count connected groups by merging them edge by edge. Each vertex points to a parent; following parents leads to a root that names the group, and path halving keeps the paths short.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Edges
inputs.hint: Edges as pairs of vertex numbers, for example 0, 1, 1, 2 means the edges 0–1 and 1–2. Vertex numbers start at 0.

inputs.name: vertices
inputs.label: Number of vertices
inputs.hint: From 1 to 8. Vertices are numbered 0 up to one less than this number.
